name: Cloudflare Workflows
summary: Cloudflare Workflows is a durable execution engine built on Cloudflare Workers. A workflow is split into steps with step.do(), each persisted and retried on failure, and can sleep or wait for external events (such as an approval) for hours or weeks without consuming CPU. It suits teams already deploying to Workers, including agents built with Cloudflare's Agents SDK.
facts: CPU time, requests, storage and steps; 500k steps/mo included, then $0.80 per 100k
goodFor: Long waits for human approval or webhooks
Idle time that costs no CPU
watchOut: Per-step and storage billing started in 2026
Workers CPU and memory limits apply
